prompt: Create one polished production-quality GAME UI redesign mockup, a single 1280 x 720 landscape 16:9 screenshot for Plants x Plants. Use the attached images as actual design references. Image 1 is the CURRENT plant selection screen: preserve its exact six fierce plant characters, their species, 3-column by 2-row selection grid, forest clearing backdrop and purpose of choosing 3 out of 6. Images 2 and 3 are the game's ACTUAL NPC dialogue panels: use their warm wooden rails, gold corner fasteners, fine dark green inner border, cream parchment fill and restrained corner leaf sprigs as the new card design language. The direction is named 'Viveiro de companheiras' for your internal understanding only: do not print this concept name. Main goal: make selection feel like the SAME botanical pixel-art game as its NPC dialogue, with clear hierarchy, larger readable plant artwork, comfortable padding and intentional spacing. No implementation, only one full-screen visual target. Native cohesive pixel-art UI, medium coarse stepped outlines and color clusters, no photorealism, no smooth modern SaaS cards, no glossy illustration. Preserve the forest background from image 1, subtly darken it for contrast, no scenery redesign. Large centered header text EXACTLY 'Quem vai com você?' rendered in the SAME chunky squared pixel typeface style as Pixelify Sans from the game's dialogue HUD; ALL other labels, stats, instructions and buttons also use this consistent crisp pixel font, never modern rounded sans serif. Under header, centered compact instruction 'Escolha 3 de 6 plantas' and selection counter '3/3 selecionadas'. Keep simple four-step progress marker small and secondary. Grid: six equal broad landscape wooden-and-parchment cards, three across and two down. Each card's outside frame is adapted DIRECTLY from the attached NPC wooden dialogue frame, scaled with deliberate borders, small gold pins, sparse leaves at two corners; don't make ornament consume the content. Inside each card: plant name in a clear top header, existing fierce plant sprite larger and entirely visible on the LEFT below the name, compact aligned attributes on the RIGHT, a small clearly readable selection status along the bottom. Preserve original fierce angry eyes and plant anatomy; do NOT make the sprites cute, do NOT add human faces. Card contents in reading order: TOP LEFT Trevo, Vida 94, ATQ 47, DEF 46, selected label '1 · Na equipe'; TOP MIDDLE Hera Venenosa, Vida 97, ATQ 47, DEF 45, selected label '2 · Na equipe'; TOP RIGHT Pimenta, Vida 89, ATQ 54, DEF 38, selected label '3 · Na equipe'; BOTTOM LEFT Cacto, Vida 100, ATQ 55, DEF 40, unselected label 'Selecionar'; BOTTOM MIDDLE Orquídea, Vida 86, ATQ 53, DEF 40, unselected label 'Selecionar'; BOTTOM RIGHT Planta Carnívora, Vida 106, ATQ 48, DEF 49, unselected label 'Selecionar'. Preserve plant identities as shown in image 1: green clover, purple thorny poison ivy, scarlet chili with small orange flames, spiny flowering cactus, large pink-purple orchid, green-red hinged carnivorous jaws. Make the TOP THREE selected cards distinguishable through a subtle light sage parchment tint plus a small numbered leaf badge; BOTTOM THREE retain neutral cream parchment. The Cacto card is keyboard FOCUSED, distinguished from selected through an amber edge accent and a tiny orange pixel pointer, not a selected fill. Do not obscure art with selection decorations. At bottom of screen, brief instruction 'Setas / WASD: navegar · Espaço ou clique: selecionar'. One wooden secondary button left labeled 'Voltar · ESC'; one larger wooden primary button right labeled 'Confirmar equipe · ENTER', enabled. Keep UI within safe 40px margins, all content inside 720px height, never cut off footer or roots. No new features, no navigation tabs, no inventory, no extra plants, no boss cards, no rarity stars, no elemental types, no coins, no character stats beyond those specified, no additional panels within panels. Single edge-to-edge game screenshot, no device/browser frame, no collage, no explanatory annotations, no watermark.
